title: Modern Imbecile's Planet World
overview: Two of Hollywood’s hottest stars learn the true meaning of “caliente.” in this absurd, irreverent comedy. One minute they’re honored guests on a NASA sponsored mission as research for an upcoming role; the next they’re stranded on an unforgiving desert planet brimming with unspeakable danger, the lone survivors of a fatal rocket crash. Now they must use every ounce of their intelligence and ingenuity if they want to make it back to earth alive.
